meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在不同坐标约定和基因组版本间转换基因组区间
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理不同工具或基因组版本的坐标数据
copy.tagline_en: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions and genome assemblies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with coordinates from different tools or genome builds

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能在 BED、GFF/GTF、VCF 等格式间换算坐标,规范化并比较变异表示,检查文件所属的基因组版本与 contig 命名是否一致,还能审计文件是否符合自身格式约定。
howto.when: 当坐标需要跨格式、工具或基因组版本转换时触发,例如处理 BED/GFF/VCF 等区间,或提到“off by one”、liftover 等关键词,或要求左对齐规范化变异。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert genomic intervals between BED/GFF/GTF/VCF, normalize and compare variant representations, check assembly and contig-naming compatibility, and audit files against format conventions.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary, such as handling BED/GFF/VCF intervals, or when keywords like "off by one" or "liftover" appear, or when variant left-normalization is requested.

say_en.text: Convert chr7:5,530,601-5,530,625 from a UCSC region string to BED coordinates.
say_en.note: Outputs the 0-based half-open interval and states the conversion direction.

say_en.text: Use ref.fa to compare chr1:7:CAC:C and chr1:2:GCA:G for equivalence.
say_en.note: Normalizes first, then compares and checks REF.

say_en.text: Check whether variants.vcf and annotation.gtf belong to the same reference genome.
say_en.note: Reports naming, length, and other incompatibilities.
